summary: Whetstone Point (Bald Mountain) lookout above Prospect, OR: crow's nest 1916, 10-ft cupola cabin 1920, removed 1958; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Camp and crow's nest platform (1916), then a D-6 cupola cabin on a 10-foot pole tower (1920)
facts.status_note: Removed in 1958; Forest Lookouts says a forestry crew burned it. No source describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: No source describes access to the site today.

events.note: Forest Lookouts timeline lists a crow's nest on an 80-foot tree; the register dates the platform to 1916
Camp and crow's nest tree platform set up (register); Foster 1916 account on the site page
Cupola cabin on a 10-foot pole tower replaced the platform (register, firelookout.com, Halls Point page give 1920)
Forest Lookouts quotes a July 1924 Medford report of a new standard lookout house, and says a house was built that year
Harry Richards was the lookout; reported shooting a panther outside the cabin in June
Nils Olson back at his post, described as his eighth year as lookout patrolman
Tower removed (register and Halls Point page)
Forest Lookouts says a forestry crew burned the cabin after a short period of abandonment

corrections.why: Every source that gives a height describes a 10-foot pole tower (about 3 m), not a structure about 24 m tall.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts' timeline lists a crow's nest on an 80-foot tree in 1914; the register and Foster's 1916 account date the platform to 1916. The story gives both dates and does not choose between them.

The register, firelookout.com and the Halls Point page date the cupola cabin to 1920; Forest Lookouts quotes a July 1924 Medford report of a new standard house. Not reconciled; the story reports both.
The register and Halls Point page say the tower was removed in 1958; Forest Lookouts says a forestry crew burned it that year. Both agree it was gone in 1958.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 24.4 is contradicted by all sources (10-foot pole tower). Access is unknown: no source found. Forest Lookouts' 1930 article gives 4685 ft for Whetstone Peak / Old Baldy, while the register gives 5,073 ft; not reconciled, and the 4685 figure is not used. Staffing 'unstaffed as of 1958' is inferred from 'short period of abandonment'. No photos added.
